purpose: Boundary performance probe for slow-pan motion refresh: only four large color ownership regions.
expected_effect: Test whether a very coarse global color refresh can pass the 100 ms p95 gate.
Reduce downstream calibration and diagnostics cost by limiting refreshed color regions.
Provide a lower-bound performance reference for future ROI refresh.
risk: Too coarse for final full-pixel clustering quality.
Expected to miss smaller far contours and should not be promoted without visual review.
